emma.k: Hi folks, first-week question. My MacBook Pro (14", M2) enrolled but I don't have admin rights to install Docker Desktop. I need it for a project starting tomorrow. Asset RWI-0999. Any way to get temporary sudo?
it-support: Welcome Emma! We don't grant permanent admin by default. Two options: a) we can grant time-limited sudo via our admin-request workflow, or b) we can push the company-approved Docker package via MDM. Which do you prefer?
emma.k: time-limited sudo would be faster for me to install dev containers. How long can it be for?
it-support: We can issue a 4-hour sudo elevation token. You'll need to request it from the Admin Access form (internal link) and confirm owner approval. If security needs more context, tag them.
security: tagging for approval. Quick Q: why Docker Desktop (which needs privileged kernel extensions) vs using `podman` or remote dev box? Is there a company image you must use?
emma.k: using Docker Desktop because some tooling (UI, credential helpers) are in the repo. I can try remote container, but the workflow is heavy-weight. Project repo: github.com/redwood/example-ml.
dev-tools: We have a signed Docker Desktop PKG in our internal repo that complies with our MDM whitelist. If you get the 4-hour sudo token, the install won't trigger extra MDM approvals. Alternatively, we can push it and skip the sudo.
it-support: If you want the sudo token, reply "approve" and we'll start the approval timer. Security will review concurrently.
emma.k: approve
security: Approved for 4 hours for asset RWI-0999. Please follow the temporary-sudo checklist: 1) don't change system-wide network settings, 2) log out when done, 3) revoke access request if you finish early.
it-support: Issuing sudo token now. Run this command to activate: `sudo-redwood-activate --token TX-9f3a`. After activation, `sudo -v` should succeed. Token expires at 2026-06-14T16:24:00Z.
emma.k: Ran activation, `sudo -v` works. Installing Docker... got a prompt about system extension blocked under Privacy & Security. Any tips?
dev-tools: On macOS Ventura+/13+, go to System Settings -> Privacy & Security -> General and click "Allow" for 'Redwood Systems' then reboot. The MDM should have approved the signed PKG so the allow button appears for 30 minutes after install attempt.
emma.k: clicked Allow and rebooted. Docker Desktop installed and I can run `docker ps`. Thanks!
mdm-bot: Notice: FileVault recovery key rotation scheduled for RWI-0999 by security at 2026-06-14T15:50:00Z. Ensure device remains online for escrow.
security: We rotated the escrowed recovery key after verifying the device enrollment and user. Token will revoke at expiry; let us know if you need an extension.
emma.k: All good. Closing thread 60a
